description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, we talk about why honor is one of the most important values we can pass on to the next generation.

This conversation reflects on the freedoms we enjoy while reminding us that having different opinions should never stop us from treating others with dignity and respect. We discuss why honoring those who have served, respecting our elders, and choosing kindness even during difficult conversations are all reflections of strong character.

We also share why teaching honor goes beyond words. The next generation learns from what we model every day, and our actions often speak louder than anything we say.

One of the biggest takeaways from this clip is that honor isn't just something we teach—it's something we live.

The way we treat others today becomes the example for tomorrow.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, faith-based encouragement, and real-world discussions.
